content.title: 39 Bob Haircut Styles for 2026
content.text: The bob haircut is experiencing a major comeback, reclaiming its place as one of the most sought-after and trending hairstyles of the moment. A timeless classic yet modern, the bob has proven its popularity through decades of re-invention. From sharp, sleek lines to tousled, voluminous layers, the bob offers endless styling possibilities that cater to a wide range of tastes and lifestyles. What makes the bob especially popular is its remarkable versatility. Whether you have fine, straight strands or thick, curly locks, there’s a bob variation out there to suit you. Similarly, the cut can be tailored to compliment any face shape – be it oval, round, heart-shaped, or square, thanks to strategic layering, length adjustments and fringe options. The bob’s adaptability and timeless nature make it a reliable go-to for those seeking a fresh yet classic look – proof that some styles never truly go out of fashion, they just evolve! In this guide, we’ll explore the key considerations when choosing the right bob haircut, the different options available and expert tips on maintaining your look! Key Considerations for a Bob Haircut Hair Type Hair texture plays a significant role in how a bob haircut will look and move, influencing everything from volume and movement to the overall shape of the cut. Here’s how different textures affect the bob: Straight Hair – typically gives the bob a sleek, polished appearance. It shows off clean lines and sharp angles, making styles such as the blunt bob or asymmetrical bob particularly striking. However, because straight hair tends to generally lie flat, it can sometimes lack volume, therefore precision cutting and styling products may be needed to add body and movement. Wavy Hair – adds natural texture and movement to a bob, giving it a relaxed, effortless feel. This texture works beautifully with layered or shaggy bobs, enhancing the dimension and softness. Wavy bobs can be styled to look very relaxed or refined, making them one of the most versatile options for this haircut. Curly Hair – brings a unique twist to the classic bob, creating a fuller, more voluminous silhouette. It transforms the shape of the cut, often requiring strategic layering to manage bulk and define curl patterns. A curly bob can range from playful and bouncy to bold and structured, depending on the curl type and cut technique. It’s important to work with a stylist experienced in cutting curls to avoid a boxy or uneven look. To get the most out of your bob, it’s essential to work with your hairs natural texture – not against it. That’s why we encourage all our clients to talk openly with their Rush stylist about their hair type, texture and daily routine. Whether your hair is straight, wavy, or curly, our expert stylists will tailor the bob to enhance your natural movement and suit your lifestyle. With the right cut and professional advice, your bob will look great, feel great and be completely unique. Face Shape Different bob styles can enhance a variety of face shapes by balancing proportions, highlighting features, and adding structure or softness where needed. Here’s how bobs can be tailored to suit different face shapes: Oval Face Shape – Often considered the most versatile face shape, an oval face can pull off nearly any style of bob. From a blunt chin-length bob to a longer, layered lob, the key is to play with the length and texture to highlight your key features. Sleek or wavy both work well for oval face shapes. Round Face Shape – For round faces, bobs that add length and angles are flattering and should be considered. A longer bob (lob) that falls just below the chin helps elongate the face and highlight the jaw structure. Opting for styles with soft layers or a deep side parting can also add definition and slim the overall silhouette. Heart Face Shape – With a wider forehead and a narrower chin, heart-shaped faces benefit from bobs that add width around the jawline. A chin-length bob with soft curls or waves creates a beautiful well-balanced look. The addition of curtain bangs or face-framing layers also work well to soften the forehead area. Square Face Shape – A square face has strong jawlines, therefore opting for a bob that softens these angles is ideal. Try a textured or layered bob that sits just below the jaw to add movement and soften the structure. Side-swept bangs or waves can also create a more rounded, gentle look. Longer Face Shape – For longer face shapes, a bob that adds volume and width is key. A chin-length or shoulder-length bob with layers, waves, or curls can make the face appear shorter and fuller. Avoid overly long or flat styles, as they can elongate the face even more. Lifestyle and Maintenance When considering a bob, it’s just as important to choose a style that aligns with your lifestyle as it is to find one that suits your face shape or hair texture. Some bobs, such as the sleek, blunt cut, require regular trims and daily styling to maintain their sharp, polished look. Others such as textured, tousled, or layered bobs offer a much more relaxed, low-maintenance approach that embraces natural movement and can air-dry beautifully. Your Rush stylist will help guide you toward a bob that not only compliments your features and hair type but also fits seamlessly into your day-to-day routine. Whether you’re looking for a quick style or love the process of daily styling, there’s a bob that will work with your lifestyle. 1. Vintage Wave Bob Brief Description – The Vintage Wave Bob is a glamorous, retro-inspired take on the classic bob, defined by its sculpted, soft waves and polished finish. Typically cut to chin or jaw-length, this style channels Old Hollywood elegance with its smooth, uniform waves that frame the face and add timeless sophistication. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Selena Gomez and Zendaya have both worn this look throughout the years Suitable Hair Types – The Vintage Wave Bob works best on straight to wavy hair types, which can hold defined waves with the help of heat styling or rollers. Medium to fine hair textures are ideal for achieving the smooth, sculpted finish that this style is known for. A length that falls between the chin and shoulders works best to show off the waves without losing definition. Styling Tips – For a longer-lasting style, set the waves using pin curls overnight and brush them out gently in the morning for soft, structured waves. Then use a medium hold hairspray to set the style whilst still allowing some flexibility. 2. Angled Bob Brief Description – The Angled Bob is a sharp, modern evolution of the classic bob, known for its shorter length at the back and gradually longer front sections that frame the face. This cut creates a clean, dynamic silhouette with an edgy vibe, offering both sophistication and structure. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Victoria Beckham and Lucy Hale have continuously been known to favourite this look throughout the years. Suitable Hair Types – The Angled Bob works well on straight to wavy hair types, which highlight its sharp lines and geometric shape. It’s particularly flattering on medium to thick textured hair, providing volume and definition. For those with curly hair, a modified version with soft layering can be tailored to work beautifully. Styling Tips – Blow-dry with a round brush to create smoothness and volume at the roots, enhancing the angled shape. 3. Ombré Bob Brief Description – The Ombré Bob combines the stylish structure of a bob haircut with the soft, graduated colour effect of ombré, that we all know and love. The look features darker roots that gradually fade into lighter ends, adding depth, dimension, and a beautiful sun-kissed finish. Paired with a bob, the colour transition enhances movement and texture. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Kylie Jenner and Jourdan Dunn are two recognisable names who love this look and have sported this many times throughout the last few years. Suitable Hair Types – The Ombré Bob works well on straight, wavy, and curly textures, as the colour transition looks seamless with any level of movement. It’s particularly eye-catching on medium to thick hair, where the contrast in tones can shine through, creating a beautiful palette. Both short chin-length bobs and longer lobs suit the ombré effect well as it gives enough length for the colour to blend through. Styling Tips – Loose waves or curls help show off the gradient colour beautifully – use a curling wand or flat iron for soft bends. 4. Razor Sharp Bob Brief Description – The Razor-Sharp Bob is a sleek, sharp haircut defined by its clean, blunt ends and bold, geometric lines. This bob delivers a crisp silhouette that’s all about structure and sophistication. It typically sits at chin or jaw length, making a dramatic, fashion-forward statement with its sharp finish. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Kim Kardashian is known to love this look and regularly changes up her style to make a real dramatic statement. Suitable Hair Types – The Razor-Sharp Bob is best suited to straight or slightly wavy hair, where its crisp edges can really stand out. Fine to medium textures work well, as they allow the hair to lie flat and emphasize the precision of the cut. It can be adapted for thicker hair however may require thinning for manageability. Styling Tips – For extra polish, finish with a light hold hairspray or shine spray to lock in the style without weighing it down. 5. Curly Bob Brief Description – The Curly Bob is a real texture focused version of the classic bob, designed to embrace and show off natural curls. Typically cut between the chin and shoulders, this style uses strategic layering to enhance curl definition, reduce bulk, and create a flattering, rounded silhouette. It’s playful, voluminous, and full of fun! Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Rihanna has loved wearing her own variation of the curly bob, helping to normalise and celebrate natural curls in fashion. The look is also gaining popularity on platforms such as TikTok, where influencers share curl routines and styling tips for short, curly cuts. Suitable Hair Types – The Curly Bob is ideal for naturally curly and coily hair types – from loose ringlets to tighter curls and 4A–4C textures. It works well on medium to thick hair, where the curls can hold their shape and volume. Lengths can vary, but shoulder-to chin-length is most common to prevent excessive bulk or shrinkage. Styling tips – Diffusing on low heat helps maintain volume and bounce while speeding up drying time. 6. Fringed Chin Bob Brief Description – The Fringed Chin Bob is a chic and youthful haircut that combines the clean, structured lines of a chin-length bob with the soft, face-framing touch of a fringe. This style draws attention to the eyes and cheekbones, offering a flattering balance of sharpness and softness. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Taylor Swift favours this look from time to time, opting for the shorter look to really change up her own look. Suitable Hair Types – The Fringed Chin Bob works best on straight to wavy hair, where the structure of the bob and the definition of the fringe can partner beautifully. It suits fine to medium textures and is great for those with oval, heart-shaped, or longer face shapes. Styling Tips – Apply a lightweight serum to smooth frizz and add shine. 7. Curtain Fringed Bob Brief Description – The Curtain Fringed Bob is a modern, effortlessly chic hairstyle that pairs a classic bob cut with soft, parted curtain bangs. The fringe gently frames the face, blending seamlessly into the rest of the bob for a flattering, face-softening effect. This style offers a perfect balance of structure and softness, giving the bob a more relaxed and wearable feel. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – This look is loved by many, but more recently by Dakota Johnson, who often opts for this shorter, fringed look. Suitable Hair Types – The Curtain Fringed Bob suits a wide range of hair textures – from straight and wavy to loose curls. It’s ideal for fine to medium hair, as the soft fringe adds volume and movement. This style flatters most face shapes, especially round, oval, and heart-shaped faces, thanks to the face-framing effect of the bangs. Styling Tips – Apply a texturising spray or light mousse to enhance volume and keep the style tousled and fresh. 8. Soft Retro Bob Brief Description – The Soft Retro Bob is a nod to vintage glamour with a modern, wearable twist. This bob features rounded edges, gentle waves or curls, and a polished, voluminous shape that dates back to the 1960s. It sits around the chin or jawline and is often paired with a subtle flip or inward curve at the ends. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Lana Del Ray is a fan of this romantic look. Suitable Hair Types – The Soft Retro Bob works well on straight to wavy hair types that can hold a styled shape. It’s ideal for fine to medium textures, as the style adds volume and fullness. Styling Tips – Use velcro rollers for extra lift and to help hold the rounded, retro shape. 9. Textured Bob Brief Description – The Textured Bob is an effortlessly cool version of the classic bob, featuring choppy layers, movement, and an undone, lived-in finish. It’s all about creating natural volume and definition, with a slightly tousled look that feels relaxed yet super stylish. Typically cut to chin or shoulder length, it offers versatility and edge. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – This look has risen in popularity thanks to the likes of Hailey Bieber and Alexa Chung favouring this look on many occasions. Suitable Hair Types – The Textured Bob suits a wide range of hair types, especially wavy, straight, and fine to medium textures. It’s ideal for adding body to fine hair and enhancing natural movement in wavy locks. With the right layering and product, even slightly curly hair can rock this look. Styling Tips – Use a texturising spray or sea salt mist to enhance natural movement and create that perfect ‘lived in’ feel. 10. Slightly Stacked Bob Brief Description – The Slightly Stacked Bob features a subtle graduated shape with shorter layers at the back that gradually lengthen toward the front. This gentle ‘stacking’ adds natural volume and lift at the crown while maintaining a soft, rounded silhouette. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – This look has previously been worn by Jennifer Aniston in her ‘Friends Era’ and more recently by Kate Hudson. Suitable Hair Types – The Slightly Stacked Bob works best on straight to wavy hair and suits fine to medium hair textures particularly well, as the stacking creates natural lift and body. Styling Tips – Apply a volumising mousse or root lift spray before drying to boost volume. 11. Graduated Bob Brief Description – The Graduated Bob is a structured, angled haircut featuring stacked layers at the back that gradually blend into longer sections at the front. It’s a bold and defined take on the classic bob. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Karlie Kloss has loved the graduated bob and regularly returns to this look. Suitable Hair Types – The Graduated Bob works best on straight to slightly wavy hair, where the structured layering and angle can be clearly defined. It suits medium to thick textures particularly well, as the cut helps manage volume while enhancing shape. Styling Tips – Opt for a deep side parting for added drama and asymmetry. 12. Modern Bob Brief Description – The Modern Bob is a fresh, modern day take on the classic bob, often defined by clean lines, soft layers, and effortless movement. It typically falls between the chin and collarbone and can be worn blunt, slightly angled, or with texture for a more relaxed finish. The beauty of the Modern Bob lies is its versatility – it blends structure with softness. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Kaia Gerber and Florence Pugh are fans of this look, and continue to embrace the versatility of the look. Suitable Hair Types – This style suits a broad range of hair types – straight, wavy, or lightly curly. It works well on fine to thick textures and is flattering on oval, heart, and square face shapes due to its adaptable structure and length. Styling Tips – Blow-dry with a round brush or paddle brush for a smooth, voluminous finish. 13. Relaxed Layered Bob Brief Description – The Relaxed Layered Bob is an easy going, textured take on the traditional bob, featuring soft, blended layers that create natural movement and a laid-back vibe. Falling anywhere from chin to shoulder length, this bob is all about effortless style. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Emily Blunt has been a lover of the relaxed bob for years, gracing the red carpets with the look all over the globe. Suitable Hair Types – Perfect for wavy, straight, or loosely curly hair, the Relaxed Layered Bob works best on fine to medium textures. Styling Tips – Use a curling wand to add loose waves, then free hand through with fingers for an undone effect. 14. Ear-Length Bob Brief Description – The Ear-Length Bob is a creative, fashion-forward haircut that sits just at or slightly below the ears. This ultra-short bob offers clean lines and a sculpted shape that highlights the jawline and neck. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Jenna Ortega and Charlize Theron are both huge fans of this look, enhancing the look to suit their own individual style. Suitable Hair Types – For those with straight to wavy hair, the Ear-Length Bob works well on fine to medium textures where the shape can remain structured and defined. It’s particularly flattering for those with oval, heart, and long face shapes, and can help create the illusion of a longer neck or more defined jawline. Styling Tips – Tuck the hair behind the ears or part deeply to the side to switch up the silhouette. 15. Retro Curtained Bob Brief Description – The Retro Curtained Bob blends together vintage-inspired charm with a modern-day edge. This style features a classic bob, typically chin to shoulder length paired with curtain bangs that sweep softly to each side. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Back in its heyday Bridgette Bardot was known for this gorgeous look, with Margot Robbie bringing it back to the forefront over recent years. Suitable Hair Types – This look suits straight to wavy hair and works well on fine to medium textures. It’s a flattering option for oval, round, and heart-shaped faces, as the curtain fringe frames the face and adds balance. Styling tips – Style the bob with loose waves using a curling wand or flat iron to enhance the retro vibe 16. ’60s Bob Brief Description – The 60’s Bob is a nod to the decade that many know and love. It’s a voluminous, rounded hairstyle inspired by the mod era, known for its structured shape and polished finish. Typically cut to the chin or just below, this bob is characterised by its rounded ends, smooth surface, and bold, clean lines. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Twiggy was the known face of this look and it quickly became a firm favourite in and out of the salons. Suitable Hair Types – Best suited for straight to slightly wavy hair with fine to medium texture. The cut works well on oval, heart, and square face shapes due to its soft, face-framing structure. Styling Tips – Add a hairband to give the look a much more vintage feel. 17. Loc Bob Brief Description – The Loc Bob is a structured hairstyle created with locs cut to a bob length – typically around the chin or shoulders. It combines the timeless bob silhouette with the natural texture of locs, offering both cultural expression and contemporary style. Celebrity/Pop Culture references – Iconic names such as Lauryn Hill have been huge fans of this look in years gone by, showing the versatility of the bob for every hair type and texture. Suitable Hair Types – best suited to those with locs. This can work for all face shapes, with length and layering completely unique to each individual. Styling Tips – Use a satin scarf or silk bonnet at night to protect the hair and reduce frizz. 18. French Bob Brief Description – The French Bob is a short style, chin length cut typically paired with blunt or softly textured fringe (bangs). Known for its effortless, undone elegance, this style oozes all things Parisian charm – sleek and incredibly chic. It frames the face and often includes slightly tousled ends for a more relaxed finish. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Kaia Gerber and Cate Blanchett have both recently experimented with this look, which has complimented both face shapes perfectly. Suitable Hair Types – The French Bob is more suited to those with straight to wavy hair, as well as those with fine to medium textures. It suits face shapes such as oval, heart and square. Styling tips – Bangs can be blow-dried straight down or swept slightly to the side for a much more relaxed look. 19. Bubble Bob Brief Description – The Bubble Bob is a rounded, voluminous bob that features a soft curve with tapered ends, creating a “bubble” effect. Often cut at jaw to mid-neck length, this playful yet polished style is all about bounce, body, and a touch of retro glamour! Celebrity/Pop Culture References – seen on celebrities such as Selena Gomez and Gigi Hadid. Suitable Hair Types – Perfectly paired for those with straight to wavy hair and fine to medium textures. It suits oval, heart, and long face shapes best, as the fullness adds width and balances the facial features. Styling tips – Lightly bend the ends inward with a straightening iron or hot brush for an elegant, curved finish. 20. Baroque Bob Brief Description – The Baroque Bob is a dramatic take on the classic bob, inspired by the elegance of the Baroque era. Characterised by rich texture, deep waves or curls, and often enhanced with a high glossy finish, this bob oozes vintage glamour and high drama. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Lana Del Ray has perfected this look many times throughout the years. Suitable Hair Types – This look works well for those who have wavy to curly textures, or straight hair styled with curls. Works well on medium to thick hair to support the volume and structure. Ideal for oval, heart, and long face shapes Styling Tips – Apply a glossing serum or shine spray for that luxurious finish. 21. ’90s Bob Brief Description – The 90’s Bob is a sleek, minimalist haircut that sits at jaw to shoulder length, often featuring blunt ends, a sharp middle part, and a smooth, polished finish. This bob reflects the clean, cool, confident vibe. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Being the must have look of the 90’s iconic names such as Winona Ryder, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jennifer Anniston. Suitable Hair Types – Those with straight to slightly wavy hair and fine to medium textures will suit this bob well. It also suits those with oval, square, and heart-shaped faces due to its strong, face-framing lines and symmetry. Styling Tips – For extra volume at the roots, blow-dry with a round brush, focusing heat at the roots. 22. Sleek Bob Brief Description – This is a polished, ultra-smooth version of the classic bob, defined by straight, glass-like strands and a sharp, precise cut. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Megan Fox has been a firm favourite, pairing this look with a strong colour palette. Suitable Hair Types – Ideal for those with straight hair with fine texture. It works best on oval, heart, and square face shapes where the sleek structure of the lines can enhance bone structure. Styling Tips – Use a fine-tooth comb and hairspray to tame flyaways for that ultra-smooth effect. 23. Asymmetrical Bob Brief Description – The Asymmetrical Bob is a look that is deliberately ‘uneven’ – shorter on one side and ever so slightly longer on the other – creating a bold cut. It’s a modern, architectural twist on the traditional bob that adds movement, intrigue, and individuality to your look. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Posh Spice AKA Victoria Beckham was the poster girl for this look. Recently Keira Knightly has been known to opt for this look. Suitable Hair Types – Works best on straight to wavy textures with fine to thick density. It flatters most face shapes, especially round and square, as the angled lines help elongate the face and add definition. Styling Tips – Consider tucking the shorter side behind the ear to highlight the asymmetry. 24. Skinny Lob Brief description – The Skinny Lob (long bob) is a sleek, elongated version of the classic bob, typically sitting lightly above the collarbone with a narrow, straight silhouette. It’s minimal, elegant, and modern — perfect for those who want length without the weight of long hair. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Trendsetters such as Kendall Jenner and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley love this look! Suitable Hair Types – Ideal for straight or slightly wavy hair with fine to medium texture. Works well on oval, heart, and round face shapes due to its face-framing, elongating effect. Styling Tip – Use a straightening iron for a sleek, straight finish, and use a shine spray for that “glass hair” effect. 25. The Slicked-Back Textured Bob Brief Description – This combines edgy structure with undone, creative movement. This style features a bob-length cut (typically jaw to shoulder length) with tousled texture throughout, while the top is styled slicked back for a bold finish. Celebrity/ Pop Culture References – Kristen Stewart and Zoë Kravitz Suitable Hair Types – Best for wavy to straight hair with medium to thick density. Adds volume and character to round, oval, and heart-shaped faces. Styling tip – Use a pomade or wax for a wet-look finish and long-lasting hold. 26. The Italian Textured Bob Brief Description – this is a luxurious, voluminous bob that oozes effortless glamour. It typically lies between the chin and shoulders and is defined by soft, relaxed layers and natural texture — think movement, body, and that perfectly “undone” vibe. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Bella Hadid has worn this look many times on the runway and red carpets! Suitable Hair Types – Perfect for wavy, curly, or textured hair types, and works especially well on medium to thick hair. Great for oval, square, and heart-shaped faces where volume and softness enhance balance and facial contours. Styling tip – For extra Italian flair, pair with a side part and add a silk scarf to accessorise. 27. Mushroom Bob Brief description – The Mushroom Bob is a bold, rounded haircut that creates a distinct mushroom like shape — very structured and full at the crown with slightly tapered or undercut edges near the neck. This strong bob has a distinctly retro-futuristic feel. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – A trend back in the 60’s and 70’s, Charlize Theron is the queen of the Mushroom bon. It has also been seen on the runways of fashion houses Prada and Miu Miu. Suitable Hair Types – Best suited for straight to slightly wavy hair and fine to medium textures, as this allows the rounded shape to stay smooth and defined. Works well with oval, heart, and long face shapes for a balanced look. Styling tips – For added edge, opt for a micro fringe to make an even bigger statement. 28. Side-Swept Lob Brief description – It’s just that, a side swept bob, with longer front sections! The look features a length that typically falls just above the shoulders, paired with a dramatic deep side part that adds instant elegance and volume. Celeb/Pop Culture References – Lucy Liu and Reese Witherspoon. Suitable Hair Types – this works incredibly well for those with straight hair that is fine to medium density. The Side Swept Lob is especially flattering on round, heart, and oval face shapes, as the side part helps elongate and contour the face Styling Tip – Set the side-swept style in place with a light-hold hairspray for a flexible, lasting hold. 29. Flipped-Out Bob Brief Description – is a playful, retro-inspired take on the classic bob, featuring ends that curve outward instead of under. Celeb/Pop Culture References – First Lady Jackie Kennedy rocked this look in the 60’s with Kourtney Kardashian sporting this look more recently. Suitable Hair Types – Great for straight to slightly wavy textures and works best on fine to medium hair. Styling Tips – Use a straightening iron or curling iron on the ends to achieve the flick. 30. Flipped-In Bob Brief Description – is a retro-inspired take on the classic bob that we all know and love, with the ends that curve inward as opposed under. Celeb/Pop Culture References – The most famous flipped in bob is of course Anna Wintour. Suitable Hair Types – Great for straight to slightly wavy textures and works best on fine to medium hair. Styling Tips – Use a straightening iron or curling iron on the ends to achieve the in ward curve. 31. Half-Up, Half-Down Bob Brief Description – The half-up, half-down bob is a popular styling take on the versatile style that combines the structure of a bob with the unique charm of an updo. With the top section pulled back, this look balances polished and relaxed vibes, making it ideal for both casual days and those special occasions. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Hailey Bieber has been a fan of this chic look on many occasions. Suitable hair types – Perfect for those individuals with straight, wavy or loosely curly textures. To recreate, medium to longer length bobs are much more adaptable to this style. Styling tips – Style the top half into a loose knot, bun, or mini ponytail to create a much more unique look. 32. The Cropped Bob Brief Description – this is a super-short, sharply defined version of the classic bob, typically cut just below the ears or at the jawline. It features clean lines, minimal layering, and a bold, sculpted shape—perfect for highlighting facial features and creating a sophisticated, fashion-forward look. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Carey Mulligan always brings this look to the forefront of every red carpet. Suitable Hair Types – Those with straight or wavy hair with a fine to medium texture can really work this look. It is best suited to those with an oval or heart face shape as it brings attention to the jawline. Styling tips – Use a smoothing serum for a gorgeous glass finish. 33. Classic Blowout Bob Brief Description – this is a timeless, voluminous bob featuring smooth, rounded ends and a full-bodied finish. Typically chin to shoulder-length, this bob is all about bounce and shine. Celebrity/Pop Culture references – Meghan Markle has sported this look over the years. Suitable Hair Type – this is the perfect look for those with straight to wavy hair and medium to thick density. Styling Tips – use velcro rollers after drying for extra bounce and long-lasting hold. 34. The Wet-Look Bob Brief Description – this is a sleek, high-shine take on the classic bob haircut, styled to appear freshly misted or just-out-of-the-water. Celebrity/Pop Culture references – this look is especially loved by Kim Kardashian who sports this look often. Suitable Hair Type – This is best suited for those with straight to wavy hair with fine to medium density, though it can be adapted for other textures with the correct styling products. Styling Tips – Begin with damp or dry hair and apply a generous amount of gel or styling creme to create the wet effect. 35. Accessorised Bob Brief Description – with this look it is less about the cut and more about the styling, enhancing a bob haircut with standout accessories such as clips, pins, headbands etc. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Lily Collins is a fashion lover who regularly experiments with accessories to suit her gorgeous style. Suitable hair types – adaptable to every hair type and texture! Styling tips – Match accessories to your outfit or mood – glitter for evening, minimalist metal for chic daywear. 36. Hollywood Bob Brief Description – The Hollywood Bob is a glamorous, red-carpet-ready version of the classic bob, defined by soft waves, high shine, and a structured silhouette. Celebrity/Pop Culture References – Made famous by the one and only Marilyn Monroe. Suitable Hair Types – Straight to wavy hair with fine to medium density. Styling Tips – Opt for a large-barrel curling tong or hot rollers to create uniform, soft waves. 37. The Feathered Bob Brief Description – this is a layered, lightweight bob which features soft, wispy-esque ends that gently fip outward, whilst blending into the rest of the hair. This bob is all about movement and texture. Celeb/Pop Culture References – Farah Fawcett highlighted this style and turned it into one of the most recognisable looks. Suitable Hair Types – best suited for those with straight to wavy hair with fine to medium density. It’s flattering for those with round, oval or heart shaped faces. Styling Tips – Apply a light mousse or volumising spray before styling to add lift and hold. 38. Layered Curly Bob Brief description – this is a voluminous, shape-enhancing hairstyle designed to compliment those natural curls. By adding strategic layers, this bob removes bulk, defines curl patterns, and creates a balanced, bouncy style. Celeb/Pop Culture References – Lorde has worn this look well throughout the years. Suitable Hair Types – Perfect for curly and coily hair types (Type 3A–4A), especially those with medium to thick density. Styling tips – Diffuse when blow-drying to maintain volume and minimize frizz or air-dry for a natural finish. 39. Face-Framing Bob Brief Description – is a flattering, sculpted variation of the bob haircut that incorporates layers or angles around the front of the face to accentuate facial features. Celeb/Pop Culture References – Another favourite look of Hailey Bieber! Suitable Hair types – Straight and wavy textures work well with this look, as well as both fine and thick hair. Styling tips – Blow-dry face-framing layers with a round brush to softly curve them toward the face. What Should I Ask My Hairdresser For? When visiting your stylist, it is vital that you bring reference images, as these visual examples help ensure clear communication, align expectations, and allow the stylist to tailor the cut and finish to suit your hair type, face shape, and lifestyle. A picture truly is worth a thousand words when it comes to achieving the perfect bob. During your consultation, discuss length, texture and layers with your stylist as three key elements are essential when creating a look which is perfect for you. Length – The length of a bob dramatically affects its overall perception and versatility. From chin-length for a bold, structured look to collarbone lobs for softness and movement, even a few inches can make a significant difference. Shorter bobs create strong, confident silhouettes, while longer bobs offer more styling flexibility. Texture – Texture adds depth and character to any look. A sleek, straight bob gives a modern, sophisticated vibe, whilst wavy or tousled textures make the look feel much more relaxed and effortless. Adding texture can also enhance volume, make fine hair appear thicker, or help reduce bulk in thicker hair types. Blending of Layers – Carefully planned blended layers ensure the bob maintains a clean shape whilst working with the hair’s natural movement. Soft, well-blended layers can lighten up dense hair and add natural movement, while more defined layers can create edge, dimension, or emphasise curls and waves. The goal is to maintain balance. Styling Your Bob Haircut For a Sleek Look To achieve a smooth and sleek bob, use a straightening iron to smooth your hair, section by section. Follow with a smoothing serum to tame flyaways and add shine – apply it sparingly from mid-lengths to ends to avoid weighing the hair down. Finish with a light mist of shine spray or anti-humidity spray for a glossy, long-lasting hold. For Textured Bobs To add natural body and texture to your bob, apply a texturising spray or lightweight mousse to damp hair before blow-drying. Focus on the roots for lift and through the mid-lengths for soft movement. A sea salt spray is perfect for a tousled, lived-in look, while a volumising mousse can give fine hair extra bounce and fullness. For a Voluminous Bob For added fullness and body, apply a light volumising mousse to damp hair, focusing on the roots. Then, blow-dry using a large round brush, lifting the hair at the roots to encourage height and curling in slightly at the ends for a smooth, voluminous finish. This technique adds natural lift and helps create a polished, salon-quality look. Tips for Maintaining a Bob Haircut Regular Trims To keep your bob looking sharp and healthy, it’s essential to visit the salon for a trim every 6–8 weeks. Regular trims help maintain the shape and structure of the cut while preventing split ends from traveling up the hair shaft. This keeps your style fresh and your hair in its best condition. Hair Care Routine It’s vital to use a nourishing shampoo and conditioner to keep your hair hydrated and healthy – especially if you have thicker or coloured hair. These formulas help replenish moisture, enhance manageability, and protect against damage. Avoiding Flatness Blow-dry your hair to boost volume, focusing on lift at the roots for a much fuller look. To maintain your body between washes, use a dry shampoo, as it not only absorbs excess oil but also adds texture and helps prevent your style from falling flat.
